title: `Strain measure` heading survives the congestion sweep inside an edited spec-4-1 line

finding.title: `Strain measure` heading survives the congestion sweep inside an edited spec-4-1 line
finding.evidence: - **Strain measure (the pinned contract):** node utilization = Σ `packet_bandwidth` of packets RESIDENT at the node that **FAILED a forward attempt** (`Packet.waiting_ticks >= 1` — incremented in flow.odin's forward pass when no route exists, cleared on every successful forward) × 100 ÷ `node_types[node_type].throughput_units` (integer percent). A packet that forwards next tick — fresh spawn OR fresh transit arrival — has `waiting_ticks` 0 and NEVER congests (the no-flicker contract; the transit case was the reason the spawn-tick exclusion alone was insufficient — see the change log). Pipe congestion = the FULLEST lane queue's depth on the bundle vs its E9 bound (`lane_queue_packets × packet_bandwidth`): a lone packet is 1/6 of a bound (17 %, healthy); a lane at its bound (6 packets) is 100 % — the ladder is dropping. "Congestion climbing toward saturation" (GDD M5), not busy-ness.
finding.detail: The PR rewrote this exact line (NEVER strains → NEVER congests; Pipe pressure → Pipe congestion) but left the pinned-contract heading naming the retired coinage — a missed rename in a swept surface.
finding.recommended_fix: Rename the heading to "Congestion measure (the pinned contract)" to match the line's body and the canon.
